title: Consolidation with CTA and Minority Interest
description: Deterministic foreign-subsidiary consolidation arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic inputs, per the translation method: equity translated at declared current and historical rates, the cumulative translation adjustment as the difference, and the parent/minority split at the declared ownership percentage. No FX feed, no ledger store, no network, no clock.

sub_equity_fc.description: Subsidiary equity in its functional currency; a finite number greater than 0.

rate_current.description: Declared current (closing) translation rate; a finite number greater than 0.

rate_historical.description: Declared historical translation rate; a finite number greater than 0.

parent_ownership_pct.description: Declared parent ownership percentage; a finite number strictly between 0 and 100.

equity_at_current.description: Subsidiary equity translated at the declared current rate, 2dp half-up; null on the fail-closed path.

equity_at_historical.description: Subsidiary equity translated at the declared historical rate, 2dp half-up; null on the fail-closed path.

cta.description: Cumulative translation adjustment: equity_at_current minus equity_at_historical.

parent_share.description: Parent's share of translated equity at the declared ownership, 2dp half-up.

minority_interest.description: Residual non-controlling interest; parent plus minority always equals translated equity.

trace.description: Full translation, CTA, and split trace, or the fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

overall.description: CONSOLIDATION_COMPUTED on any well-formed input; CONSOLIDATION_REFUSED on the fail-closed path.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_consolidation_cta
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes foreign-subsidiary consolidation figures from declared inputs: equity translated at declared current and historical rates (2dp half-up), the cumulative translation adjustment as the difference, and the parent/minority-interest split at the declared ownership percentage. Translation and split arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic inputs only: no accounting advice, no framework-conformance determination, and nothing is posted anywhere.
